user_request: 메인스플래시 화면 구현하려함 이미지생성모델기반 목업ㄱ 그거다음에 여행선택화면으로이어지게할것
prompt: Create a mobile UI mockup for TripLOG showing two consecutive app screens side by side, each designed for a 390 × 844 px viewport, with an arrow between them indicating automatic progression. The first screen is the main splash: make “TripLOG” the primary focus, followed by the short Korean line “떠날 여행도, 다녀온 순간도” and a small loading indication with “여행을 준비하고 있어요”. Keep the splash information minimal and the text easy to read. The second screen is the travel selection screen: show a smaller “TripLOG” brand mark, the title “내 여행”, the subtitle “떠날 여행도, 다녀온 순간도”, a search field labeled “여행 이름이나 여행지 검색”, filters “ALL”, “UP NEXT”, and “MEMORIES”, and a two-column collection of selectable trips with names, dates, and destinations. Use two illustrative sample entries: “제주 여행”, “2026.11.07 – 11.09”, “JEJU”; and “오사카 여행”, “2026.12.12 – 12.15”, “OSAKA”. Include a clear “새 여행 만들기” action. Prioritize the splash identity first and the travel choices second. The splash automatically leads into travel selection when ready. Explore a fresh visual direction with a coherent identity across both screens.
variant: 01 — Main splash and travel selection flow
selection_status: concept delivered; not selected for implementation

proposed_flow.transition: 일반 앱 시작에서 준비 완료 후 자동 전환. 정확한 표시 시간과 모션은 구현 시 결정.
proposed_flow.preserve_direct_links: trip이 포함된 직접 링크, 초대, 비밀번호 복구 목적지는 유지한다.

sample_data: 제주 여행과 오사카 여행 및 날짜는 목업 전용 가상 예시.
scope: 이미지 생성 기반 디자인 목업. 앱 코드/라우팅 수정, 커밋, 푸시, 배포 없음.
